svg.title: A sheet of fiche (rows A to N, columns 1 to 12)
svg.desc: A sheet of microfiche as scratchboard: a black card with a header strip cut in white capitals (RCC, SUBJECT INDEX, SHEET), row letters A to N down the side, column numbers 1 to 12 along the top, and a grid of 168 tiny frames, each with a few cut lines of unreadable text.
